questions.question: In Dynamic Random-Access Memory (DRAM), which two primary components are used to store a single bit of data?
options: A flip-flop and an inverter
A transistor and a capacitor
A resistor and an inductor
A NAND gate and a NOR gate
A multiplexer and a demultiplexer

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of a computer system implementing *virtual memory*?
options: To increase the physical speed of RAM access.
To allow multiple processes to share the same physical memory securely and efficiently, providing each with its own private address space.
To reduce the power consumption of the CPU.
To enable faster execution of arithmetic logic unit (ALU) operations.
To provide a direct interface for graphics processing units (GPUs) to access system memory.

questions.question: In synchronous digital IC design, what is the primary goal of synthesizing a Clock Distribution Network (CDN), often referred to as a "clock tree"?
options: To minimize the total power consumption of the logic gates.
To optimize the timing of asynchronous communication between different clock domains.
To ensure all flip-flops receive the clock signal at approximately the same time, minimizing clock skew and maintaining setup/hold times.
To reduce the number of transistors required for the clock generation circuitry.
To allow the CPU to dynamically adjust its operating frequency based on workload.

questions.question: In a multi-core processor system, what is the primary function of a *cache coherence protocol* (e.g., MESI)?
options: To ensure that all memory requests are routed through a single, centralized cache controller for arbitration.
To maintain a consistent view of shared memory data across all local caches in the system.
To predict future memory accesses and prefetch data into the caches to reduce latency.
To provide an isolated and secure memory space for each individual processor core.
To convert virtual memory addresses into physical memory addresses for cache lookups.

questions.question: After the logical synthesis of a digital circuit (converting RTL to a gate-level netlist), what is the typical next major step in the ASIC design flow before physical layout begins?
options: Post-silicon validation and characterization.
Design for Testability (DFT) insertion and verification.
High-Level Synthesis (HLS) from C/C++.
Fabrication of the integrated circuit.
Software application development for the target chip.
